# NP Basics

> NP Basics is a free exam-prep app from Grip Theory LLC for the AANPCB FNP and ANCC FNP, with 627 practice questions, a rationale for every answer choice, and mock exams built to the official test plans.

- Publisher: Grip Theory LLC
- Price: free today, with no account and no ads. A paid plan, Pro, starts in January 2027; the question of the day, the daily plan, the Reference and one mock exam stay free.
- Platforms: Android (Google Play) and any web browser; the iPhone app is coming
- Practice questions: 627, each with a rationale for every answer choice

## Exams
- AANPCB FNP: 537 practice questions. Exam guide: https://npbasics.com/sheets/guide-aanpcb-fnp.html. Sample questions: https://npbasics.com/practice/aanpcb-fnp.html
- ANCC FNP: 627 practice questions. Exam guide: https://npbasics.com/sheets/guide-ancc-fnp.html. Sample questions: https://npbasics.com/practice/ancc-fnp.html

## Main pages
- [Home](https://npbasics.com/): what the app covers
- [Web app](https://npbasics.com/app/): the full question bank, free in any browser
- [Sample questions](https://npbasics.com/practice/): questions with answers and rationales
- [Cheat Sheets and exam guides](https://npbasics.com/sheets/): study summaries with sources
- [Reference](https://npbasics.com/reference/): every drug, calculator, lab group and quick card set on its own page

## Reference
- [Drugs](https://npbasics.com/drugs/): 48 pages. Monographs: indications, doses, mechanism, pharmacokinetics and cautions
- [Calculators](https://npbasics.com/calculators/): 26 pages. Working calculators with the formula and how to read the result
- [Lab values](https://npbasics.com/labs/): 8 pages. Reference ranges in US and SI units
- [Quick cards](https://npbasics.com/cards/): 5 pages. Bedside tables and checklists
